Title: Public preview: Azure Maps Creator feature - Wayfinding

Body.Content:
Wayfinding in Azure Maps Creator enables you to provide your users with the shortest path between two points within a facility.

Azure Maps Creator has added a new feature, Wayfinding. With wayfinding, you can now create a route set for your indoor maps. This feature will work with any single or multilevel facility in Creator. Now, navigate from any two points within a facility by requesting the shortest path.  

To get started with Azure Maps Creator Wayfinding, see how-to Wayfinding.

To get started with Azure Maps and Azure Maps Creator, see the Azure Maps documentation or create a free Azure Maps account.
